newsitem.title: USA: Minn. Gov signs $758 mln omnibus tax bill.
newsitem.headline: Minn. Gov signs $758 mln omnibus tax bill.

text.p: Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson has signed a $758 million omnibus tax bill that includes a one-time $500 million property tax rebate.

The tax package signed Monday by Carlson also includes a six percent property tax rate reduction for commercial/industrial class properties in 1998 and cuts for residential homestead, non-homestead, apartments and utility property, the governor said in a statement.
"With property tax increases being spread more equitably on all types of property, the voters will place additional pressure on their local governments to restrain spending," Carlson said.

Homeowners and renters will receive a 20 percent rebate of property taxes paid in 1997 as a refundable credit on their 1998 income tax returns. Renters will receive longterm relief through expanded rental credits.
